newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures end down in thin turnover.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures end down in thin turnover.

text.p: Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Monday"s Tokyo session lower. Activity was limited due to a lack of fresh incentives, traders said.
The key March futures contract closed down 0.09 at 126.06, after trading between 126.02 and 126.22. Turnover was 30,642 contracts.
Several large-lot sell orders, each of about 50 billion yen, were seen in the afternoon after the March hit the intraday high of 126.22, traders said.
But these sell orders were well-absorbed and were not enough to push the March below 126.00, they said.
